testPlans.content:
Test Plan Document for Project: AmozIT

Objective:
The objective of this test plan is to ensure the quality and functionality of the AmozIT project, which consists of two mobile applications (customer app and service provider app), a company admin panel, and a super admin panel.

Scope:
The testing will focus on all aspects of the customer app, service provider app, company admin panel, and super admin panel. This includes but is not limited to, functionality, user interface, performance, security, and compatibility testing.

Approach:
The testing approach will include manual testing as well as automation testing where applicable. Testing will be conducted by a dedicated QA team in collaboration with the development team.

Entry Criteria:
- All features and functionalities of the applications and panels are completed
- Test environments are set up and ready for testing
- Test data is available and ready for use

Exit Criteria:
- All high priority bugs are fixed and verified
- The applications and panels meet the acceptance criteria defined by the stakeholders
- Test reports are generated and shared with the stakeholders

Risks:
- Integration issues between the customer app, service provider app, and admin panels
- Security vulnerabilities in the applications
- Compatibility issues with various devices and operating systems

Timeline:
The testing phase is scheduled to begin on [start date] and conclude on [end date]. The exact duration of the testing phase will depend on the complexity of the project and the number of issues identified during testing.

This test plan document will be updated as needed throughout the testing phase to reflect any changes or updates.

scenarios.title: Verify user authentication process
scenarios.description: Ensure that users can successfully log in and log out of the customer app, service provider app, company admin panel, and super admin panel using valid credentials. Check for any issues with password recovery or account creation processes.
